Item.name: Small Swimbladder
Item.description: A tiny swim bladder from a small or immature creature though similar to those from larger Europan lifeforms, containing tissue fluids that can be easily processed into stabilozine and saline.

Item.name: Decaying Klaxon
Item.description: A blaring reactor klaxon leaking putrid corroded fluids, its somehow still producing an awful noise while visibly falling apart.

Item.name: Light tool
Item.description: Shine like a star! Like a terrible, bloodthirst, underwater star...

Item.name: Burnt Oxygenite
Item.description: A polluted oxygenite shard that reeks of charred meat and engine fumes. Oddly stable it now also produces carbon monoxide which displaces oxygen in hemoglobin, how the spliced can breath using this is a mystery.
